query: SELECT z.id, z.partId, z.purpose, z.posX, z.posY, z.width, z.height, pp.`key` as partKey FROM product_zones z JOIN product_parts pp ON pp.id = z.partId WHERE pp.productId = 1380006 AND pp.`key` LIKE '%aermel%';
